**Style:** Hyperrealistic cinematic - Baroque pop performance

An anthropomorphic golden-orange tabby cat stands center stage on polished dark walnut wood, dressed in an ornate baroque-style gold-and-black patterned silk shirt with ruffled cuffs and tailored black shorts, feet adorned in glossy black leather dress shoes. The feline performer maintains humanoid posture throughout, costume details remaining crisp and undistorted.

**Camera & Cinematography:** Opening with a **medium shot (waist-up)**, the camera executes a **slow, intimate push-in** that gradually tightens to **chest-close-up** by [09-11s], then **micro-zooms into an extreme close-up of the left eye** as the tear falls at [10s], before **easing back to a medium close-up** with a **slight Dutch tilt** (3 degrees) to emphasize emotional vulnerability at [13-16s]. **Static lock-off** during lip-sync moments, **buttery smooth dolly** movements between emotional beats. Stage-left key lighting creates dramatic isolation, warm amber spotlight with subtle haze/atmosphere diffusion, cinematic 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field (f/1.8), 4K resolution.

**Temporal Choreography:**

**[0-3s]** Sings "Love breaks the heart" (爱到心心碎): Mouth opens wide forming "Ai" and "Sui" phonetic shapes, brows tightly furrowed, eyes conveying profound sorrow with glistening unshed tears. Right paw lifted delicately to chest, trembling slightly to manifest heartache.

**[3-5s]** Sings "Don't blame anyone" (也别去怪谁): Lip sync transitions smoothly from "Bie" to "Shui" shapes, expression shifting to resigned acceptance with gentle head shake, gaze softening into tender melancholy.

**[5-8s]** Sings "Only because the encounter was too beautiful" (只因为相遇太美): Singing "Encounter" (Xiangyu) with softened, nostalgic eyes; head tilts subtly upward. At "Too beautiful" (Tai mei), a bittersweet smile touches the corners of the mouth, eyes gazing distantly into treasured memory.

**[9-11s]** Sings "Even if tears run dry" (就算流干泪): Expression returns to sorrow, mouth forms round "Lei" shape, a single crystalline tear traces down from the left eye corner—maintaining elegant composure without facial contortion.

**[11-12s]** Sings "Wounded completely" (伤到底): Jaw clenches with determined resilience, sharp, forceful lip articulation, eyes burning with steadfast resolve.

**[12-13s]** Sings "Heart turns to ash" (心成灰): Mouth slightly open forming "Hui" shape, eyes hollow for a fleeting moment before refocusing sharply, embodying complex emotions of love's death without regret.

**[13-16s]** Sings "Also doesn't matter" (也无所谓): Chin lifts with defiant grace, firm lip sync precision, eyes locking directly into lens with unwavering courage—radiating absolute devotion and fearless acceptance of love's consequences.
